title: Central Omega Resources Reports Record Production and Profit Surge in First Half of 2025
body: PT Central Omega Resources Tbk saw nickel ore production jump 140% to 1.73 Mt and sales rise 159% to 1.83 Mt in H1 2025, while net profit climbed 38% to Rp310.3 bn and EBITDA surged 219% to Rp481.4 bn, driven by full‑scale mining operations and a new 2024 RKAB. The company remains optimistic for the rest of 2025 but warns of potential US tariff uncertainties, pledging to boost efficiency, explore new reserves, and adopt sustainable resource management.

title: Indonesia's Nickel Prices Rise in Early October 2025, APNI Calls for Market‑Reflective Adjustments
body: APNI released that nickel reference prices for the first half of October 2025 climbed to US$15,101.67 per dmt, up from US$15,000.33 in the second half of September, with detailed rates for grades ranging from 1.60% to 2.00% and MC variations. The association praised the transparency of the calculation formula but urged the government to adjust prices to better reflect market realities, especially for low‑grade domestic miners, and emphasized the need for continued dialogue to maintain a healthy industry climate.

title: Merdeka Battery's Nickel Ore Production Surges 78% in H1 2025 Despite Revenue Decline
body: In the first half of 2025, Merdeka Battery’s SCM mine produced 6.9 Mt of wet nickel ore—a 78% YoY jump driven by 45% growth in limonit and 189% in saprolit—while downstream NPI output fell 23% but its cash cost dropped below $10k/ton. The company also sold 9,465 t of MHP from its ESG HPAL plant, advanced a 90k t/yr HPAL at Sulawesi Nickel Cobalt to 29% progress, and is building two FPPs and a slurry pipeline to feed Morowali HPAL, positioning it for a cost‑efficient, end‑to‑end nickel supply chain.
